title: A home for work, projects and everything in between.
excerpt: A little corner for the things i build, the work i do and the interests that make me, me.

body.text: Welcome to psrmalam. i am Jae, and this is my little corner of the internet. It brings together my projects, past work, hobbies and the things i am figuring out along the way.
Projects is home to InsourceAI, GoldenWax and Cream. Works covers the companies, campaigns and creative work i have been part of, with a few results and numbers along the way.

Hobby is for Pokémon cards, pack openings on TikTok, comic book collecting and running. About me has the short introduction and my education. The blog is where i can put the thoughts that do not quite fit anywhere else.
A place to keep adding to
i want this to feel like a place to explore and come back to. More projects, notes and pieces of life will find their way here as i go.
